packageRules.description: chalk 6 is ESM-only; the CLI packages (create, create-monorepo, dev-scripts) are CommonJS. Lift after they migrate to ESM.
clibuilder 11 is ESM-only and drops createCli/createCommand; dev-scripts and the other CLIs need a rewrite first.
update-notifier 6+ is ESM-only; the CJS bin entry points need an ESM migration first.
The packageManager pin is toolchain, so non-major updates merge themselves.
The toolchain pins (mise, nvm) move with packageManager, so they merge themselves too.

devDependencies only: patch and minor merge themselves once CI is green. Runtime dependencies, peerDependencies and every major stay manual — this repo publishes a toolchain other packages install, so a bump there is a consumer-visible change someone should choose.
